title: Object Lock
shortDescription: Setting an indefinite (legal hold) or temporary (retention) lock on object deletion, as well as configuring the default retention lock
metaDescription: All available methods for working with object locking in VK Object Storage: set or remove a legal hold (PutObjectLegalHold), get the legal hold status (GetObjectLegalHold), set, configure or remove a retention lock (PutObjectRetention), get the retention lock status (GetObjectRetention), set, configure or remove the default retention lock (PutObjectLockConfiguration), or get the default retention lock status (GetObjectLockConfiguration)
